completion:
Locate the vehicle mileage (Type V input).
3. Look for information about any potential problems with the brake system.
4. If there is information about brake issues, record it in the "Defects" column by marking the "Defects" box and writing "No defects" in the "Notes" column.
5. If the brake test fails, record it in the "Defects" column under the "Defects" box and in the "Notes" column as well as the cause of the failure (e.g., defective brake system, damaged brake pads).
